premises.text: Plastic gift cards end up lost, stolen, or forgotten, leaving billions unspent and hurting retailers
premises.evidence_span: there's $20 billion in unspent gift cards every year? And that's because your gift cards end up lost, stolen, or forgotten

premises.text: Mobile app stores gift cards securely in the cloud with merchant select, code entry, balance verification, and barcode or scratch redemption
premises.evidence_span: My cards are now securely backed up in the cloud, and no more forgetting them at home

premises.text: Facebook-integrated sending with a personalization engine suggests merchants and notifies around events like birthdays
premises.evidence_span: Gift is seamlessly integrated with Facebook for convenience around sending gift cards to friends and family. Our patent-pending personalization engine will suggest relevant merchants your friends will enjoy

premises.text: Anyone can receive and use cards regardless of phone type, and unwanted cards can be regifted
premises.evidence_span: anyone can receive a card on gift, regardless of what type of phone you have

premises.text: Launch with 200+ national retail partners makes it the largest mobile gift card store; open APIs will let retailers push cards later
premises.evidence_span: we've secured over 200 national retail partners to launch with our app, including Sephora, Gap, Amazon, and Lowe's, making us the largest mobile gift card store

domains.name: Lost and unspent plastic gift cards

value.text: Make gift cards fun, social, and easy to manage and redeem from a phone
value.evidence_span: We're making gift cards fun, and we're making gift cards social

secondary_value.text: Reduce unspent gift-card waste for consumers and retailers
secondary_value.evidence_span: that's bad for consumers, but it's really bad for retailers

making us the largest mobile gift card store
